summary: FS Bancorp, Inc. filed an 8-K to report its quarterly earnings and declare a regular $0.29/share cash dividend, the 53rd consecutive quarterly dividend. The filing includes financial results for the quarter ended March 31, 2026, and a dividend payable on May 21, 2026, to holders of record on May 7, 2026. There is no special-situation event such as an acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return beyond a routine dividend, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or management change. The mention of a prior merger is historical context, not the subject of this 8-K. This is a routine earnings and dividend announcement.
